name: updateDesign
description: Changes how the locations screens look, leaving every design choice not mentioned as it was.

listViewPosition.description: Where the list sits over the map when the screen opens. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

listViewStyle.description: How each location looks in the list. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

defaultMapType.description: The map's look when it opens. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

detailsMapPosition.description: Where the map sits on a location's details page. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

enableMapTerrainView.description: Whether the map shows terrain. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

hideQuickFilter.description: Whether the quick category filter is hidden. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

allowStyleSelection.description: Whether app users can switch the map style. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

showDetailsCategory.displayName: Show category and subcategory on location details screen
showDetailsCategory.description: Whether a location's category shows on its details page. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

showContributorName.description: Whether the name of the app user who added a location is shown. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with the saved design.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when nothing to change is passed or a choice is left empty.
